mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guacamole_user_password_reset (token_hash, user_id, created, expires) VALUES ( #{token.tokenHash,jdbcType=BINARY}, #{token.userID,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{token.created,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{token.expires,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )
mapper.select: SELECT guacamole_user_password_reset.token_hash, guacamole_user_password_reset.user_id, guacamole_entity.name AS username, guacamole_user_password_reset.created, guacamole_user_password_reset.expires, guacamole_user_password_reset.used FROM guacamole_user_password_reset JOIN guacamole_user ON guacamole_user_password_reset.user_id = guacamole_user.user_id JOIN guacamole_entity ON guacamole_user.entity_id = guacamole_entity.entity_id WHERE guacamole_user_password_reset.token_hash = #{tokenHash,jdbcType=BINARY} AND guacamole_user_password_reset.used IS NULL AND guacamole_user_password_reset.expires > #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
